title: Fast 2-Hour Crispy No-Knead French Baguettes
ingredients: 3.25 cups (400g) bread flour or all-purpose flour
1.5 tsp (5g) instant dry yeast + 1 tsp honey or sugar
instructions: Dissolve instant yeast and honey in warm water, then stir in flour and sea salt with a wooden spoon until a sticky dough forms (no kneading required).
Cover and let rise in a warm spot for 60–75 minutes until doubled and bubbly, performing one quick stretch-and-fold at the 30-minute mark.
Turn dough out onto a generously floured surface, divide in half lengthwise, and gently twist/shape into two rustic baguettes on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Score the tops with a razor blade, mist with water, and bake at 460°F (240°C) with a pan of hot water on the bottom rack for 20–22 minutes until crisp and golden.
